title: Initiative Cobblemon
description: A Cobblemon-based modpack that includes improved vanilla functionalities and features, incorporating some characteristics of Pokémon video game progression.
body:
# 🎮 Initiative Cobblemon 🚀

> ***✨ The Ultimate Pokemon Experience in Minecraft! ✨***

Tired of the same old Minecraft? Ready for an epic journey? Initiative Cobblemon is a meticulously crafted modpack that seamlessly blends the beloved world of Pokémon with the creative freedom of Minecraft, creating the most complete and thrilling experience available!

### 🏆 What Awaits You? 
**⚔️ An Epic Pokemon Journey**

🏛️ **Become the Champion:** Challenge powerful Gym Leaders and prove your skills in a progression system inspired by the classic Pokemon games!

🌍 **Temples & Legends:** Discover ancient temples scattered across the world and solve their mysteries to summon and battle Legendary Pokemon!

🏕️ **Dynamic Raids:** Team up with friends to take down challenging raids for epic rewards!

🗺️ **Structured Progression:** Follow a clear path of combat and exploration, just like in the official games.

### 🛠️ Enhanced Minecraft Gameplay
**🌾 Smart Automation:** Say goodbye to grinding! With mods like Easy Mob Farm and Botany Pots, you can auto-farm both mobs and resources effortlessly.

**📦 Sleek Storage:** Manage your items with ease using the powerful Refined Storage system, keeping your base tidy and efficient.

**🏡 Beautiful Builds:** Enhance your world with decorative mods like Supplementaries, Handcrafted, and Chipped to create the Pokemon region of your dreams.

**⚡ Performance Optimized:** Enjoy a smooth experience with performance mods like Sodium, Lithium, and ModernFix. We recommend 4GB of allocated RAM for the best performance.

### 🎨 Immersive Visuals & Quality of Life
**🎨 Fresh Textures & Animations:** Includes the stunning Fresh Animations resource pack and others to make your Pokemon and the world come alive.

**🎵 Cobblemon Additions:** Benefit from a huge selection of addons like Mega Showdown, SimpleTMs, CobbleNav, and many more that expand gameplay, moves, and features.

**✅ User-Friendly Tweaks:** Packed with QoL mods like Jade (for tooltips), Xaero's Minimap, Better Advancements, and Inventory Management to make your life easier.

## ⚠️ Important Notes
Space Cube Mod Warning

> **🚨 CRITICAL**  When using the Space Cube mod:

**Do NOT break Space Cubes after placing them** - this will unlink them from the space dimension and cause issues

**Do NOT close the game while inside a Space Cube** - this can sometimes break your game when rejoining and trying to exit the Space Cube

Always exit to the overworld before logging out or breaking the cube!

## 🚀 Features at a Glance

**🐾 Core**

Pokemon	Cobblemon, Mega Evolutions, Alpha Pokemon, Legendary Temples, Gym Leaders, Raid Dens

**🏗️ Automation & Tech**

Refined Storage, Botany Pots, Easy Mob Farm, Growable Ores, Vein Miner

**🎨 Aesthetics & Builds**

Biomes O' Plenty, Supplementaries, Handcrafted, Chipped, Beautify

**⚡ Performance & QoL**

Sodium, Lithium, ModernFix, Jade, Xaero's Minimap, Inventory Tweaks

**🔧 Gameplay Enhancements**

Waystones, Sophisticated Storage/Backpacks, Trinkets, Artifacts, Gravestones

### ⚙️ Technical Specs & Recommendations

**Minecraft Version:** 1.21.1

**Modloader:** Fabric

**✅ Required RAM:** We recommend allocating at least 4-6 GB of RAM for a smooth experience.

**🎭 Shaders:** For the best performance, it is recommended to deactivate shaders. The pack is visually stunning even without them!

**💻 Server Ready!** This modpack is specially designed with server play in mind and is a work in progress, meaning your feedback can help shape its future!

**🎯 Ready to Start Your Adventure?**

Dive into a world where every corner holds a new discovery and every battle brings you closer to becoming a Pokemon Master. Download now and begin your Initiative Cobblemon today!

***Let's play together!***

# 🎮 Iniciativa Cobblemon 🚀

> ***✨ ¡La Experiencia Pokémon Definitiva en Minecraft! ✨***

¿Cansado del mismo Minecraft de siempre? ¿Listo para una épica aventura? Iniciativa Cobblemon es un modpack meticulosamente creado que combina perfectamente el amado mundo de Pokémon con la libertad creativa de Minecraft, ¡creando la experiencia más completa y emocionante disponible!

### 🏆 ¿Qué Te Espera?
**⚔️ Una Épica Aventura Pokémon**
**🏛️ Conviértete en Campeón:** ¡Enfréntate a poderosos Líderes de Gimnasio y demuestra tu habilidad en un sistema de progresión inspirado en los juegos clásicos de Pokémon!

**🌍 Templos y Leyendas:** Descubre templos antiguos esparcidos por el mundo y resuelve sus misterios para invocar y luchar contra ¡Pokémon Legendarios!

**🏕️ Incursiones Dinámicas:** ¡Únete a tus amigos para derrotar incursiones desafiantes y obtener recompensas épicas!

**🗺️ Progresión Estructurada:** Sigue un camino claro de combate y exploración, ¡como en los juegos oficiales!

### 🛠️ Gameplay de Minecraft Mejorado
**🌾 Automatización Inteligente:** ¡Di adiós a la grind! Con mods como Easy Mob Farm y Botany Pots, puedes farmear automáticamente tanto mobs como recursos sin esfuerzo.

**📦 Almacenamiento Elegante:** Gestiona tus objetos fácilmente con el potente sistema Refined Storage, manteniendo tu base ordenada y eficiente.

**🏡 Construcciones Hermosas:** Mejora tu mundo con mods decorativos como Supplementaries, Handcrafted y Chipped para crear la región Pokémon de tus sueños.

**⚡ Rendimiento Optimizado:** Disfruta de una experiencia fluida con mods de rendimiento como Sodium, Lithium y ModernFix. Recomendamos 4GB de RAM asignada para el mejor rendimiento.

### 🎨 Visuales Inmersivos y Calidad de Vida
**🎨 Texturas y Animaciones Frescas:** Incluye el impresionante pack de recursos Fresh Animations y otros para dar vida a tus Pokémon y al mundo.

**🎵 Adiciones de Cobblemon:** Benefíciate de una gran selección de addons como Mega Showdown, SimpleTMs, CobbleNav y muchos más que expanden el gameplay, movimientos y características.

**✅ Tweaks Amigables para el Usuario:** Lleno de mods de calidad de vida como Jade (para tooltips), Xaero's Minimap, Better Advancements e Inventory Management para hacer tu vida más fácil.

## ⚠️ Notas Importantes

Advertencia del Mod Space Cube

> **🚨 CRÍTICO:** Al usar el mod Space Cube:

**NO rompas los Space Cubes después de colocarlos** - esto los desvinculará de la dimensión espacial y causará problemas

**NO cierres el juego mientras estés dentro de un Space Cube** - esto a veces puede romper tu juego al reconectarte e intentar salir del Space Cube

¡Siempre sal al overworld antes de cerrar sesión o romper el cubo!

## 🚀 Características Principales

**🐾 Principal**

Cobblemon, Mega Evoluciones, Pokémon Alfa, Templos Legendarios, Líderes de Gimnasio, Guaridas de Incursiones

**🏗️ Automatización y Tecnología**

Refined Storage, Botany Pots, Easy Mob Farm, Growable Ores, Vein Miner

**🎨 Estética y Construcción**

Biomes O' Plenty, Supplementaries, Handcrafted, Chipped, Beautify

**⚡ Rendimiento y Calidad de Vida**

Sodium, Lithium, ModernFix, Jade, Xaero's Minimap, Inventory Tweaks

**🔧 Mejoras de Gameplay**

Waystones, Sophisticated Storage/Backpacks, Trinkets, Artifacts, Gravestones

### ⚙️ Especificaciones Técnicas y Recomendaciones

**Versión de Minecraft:** 1.21.1

**Modloader:** Fabric

**✅ RAM Requerida:** Recomendamos asignar al menos 4-6 GB de RAM para una experiencia fluida.

**🎭 Shaders:** Para el mejor rendimiento, se recomienda desactivar los shaders. ¡El pack es visualmente impresionante incluso sin ellos!

**💻 ¡Listo para Servidor!** Este modpack está especialmente diseñado para jugar en servidor y está en desarrollo, ¡lo que significa que tus comentarios pueden ayudar a darle forma en el futuro!

**🎯 ¿Listo para Comenzar tu Aventura?**

Sumérgete en un mundo donde cada esquina esconde un nuevo descubrimiento y cada batalla te acerca a convertirte en un Maestro Pokémon. ¡Descarga ahora y comienza tu Iniciativa Cobblemon hoy mismo!

***¡Juguemos juntos!***

## Modpack Contents

This modpack will allow clients to connect to servers that only run Cobblemon and Fabric API. If you want to get any of these mods for personal use, please download them from their original pages to support their authors.

**Mods**

Advanced Loot Info - EMI plugin for displaying loot table information.

Ambient Environment - Adds color noise to biome colors.

AppleSkin - Displays more information about food-related values.

Bad Wither No Cookie - Reloaded - Changes many loud server-wide broadcast sounds to be local.

Better Advancements - Enlarges the advancement page and displays progress info.

Better Ping Display - Displays each player's ping in the player list as a number in (ms).

Better Third Person - Allows independent rotation of the camera in third-person view.

Biomes O' Plenty - Adds new biomes and world generation features.

Botany Pots - Automated farming system using decorative pots.

Botany Pots Tiers - Adds tiered botany pots for improved farming.

Carry On - Allows carrying of tile entities and mobs.

CIT Resewn - Adds support for MCPatcher's Custom Item Textures (CIT) for resource packs.

Clumps - Groups EXP orbs in close proximity together into a single entity to reduce lag.

Cobblemon - Adds Pokémon to Minecraft with full battle systems and mechanics.

Cobblemon Additions - Additional features and content for Cobblemon.

Cobblemon Mega Showdown - Adds Mega Evolution mechanics to Cobblemon.

Cobblemon Opponents - Adds challenging trainer battles throughout the world.

Continuity - Connected textures for resource packs.

Controlling - Improves the keybind search and management.

Dynamic FPS - Automatically reduces FPS when game is not focused to save resources.

Easy Mob Farm - Automated mob farming systems.

Entity Culling - Skips rendering entities you can't see to improve performance.

Entity Model Features (EMF) - Adds support for OptiFine's Custom Entity Models (CEM) for resource packs.

Entity Texture Features (ETF) - Adds support for OptiFine's Entity Texture Features (ETF) for resource packs.

Explorers Compass - Helps locate specific biomes in the world.

FancyMenu - Customizes the main menu with advanced features.

FerriteCore - Optimizes memory usage.

Fight or Flight - Improves combat mechanics and movement.

Forgiving Void - Prevents death from falling into the void in certain situations.

Fresh Animations - Enhanced animations for entities and characters.

GeckoLib - Animation library used by various mods.

Growable Ores - Allows ores to grow and spread naturally.

Handcrafted - Adds decorative furniture and building blocks.

ImmediatelyFast - Optimizes immediate rendering for better performance.

Inventory Profiles Next - Advanced inventory management and sorting.

Iris Shaders - Shader pack support and compatibility.

Jade - Shows detailed information about blocks and entities when looking at them.

Konkrete - Library for GUI improvements.

Krypton - Optimizes the networking stack.

Legendary Monuments - Adds impressive structures and monuments to explore.

Lithium - Adds many game optimizations for better performance.

Lucky Block Cobblemon - Adds lucky blocks with Pokémon-themed rewards.

Mod Menu - Allows in-game configuration of Fabric mods.

ModernFix - Modern performance improvements and bug fixes.

More Culling - Additional rendering optimizations.

More Radical Trainers - Adds more diverse and challenging trainer battles.

Natures Compass - Helps locate specific biomes.

NetherPortalFix - Fixes issues with nether portal linking in multiplayer.
